scope: R126 Paper 22 p053/p055-p061 carry-forward plus p064-p069 RA62 reaudit and source-repair package
publication_decision: Queue as the current compact Noether Paper 22 source-support addendum for a future deliberate rollup after pruning/replacement. This supersedes the p053-only, p053+p055-p058, and p053+p055-p061 packages for current staging. Do not upload loose while the Noether record is at the Zenodo 100-file ceiling.
status_additions: Carries forward the earlier P22 p053 title/editor/footnote-anchor fix and pp.55-61 bounded varrho notation repair.
Adds P22 p64 repair: source-visible xi_i and a_i^(i) in the opening linear-form setup replace the inherited xi_lambda / a_lambda^(i) readings at the checked locus.
Adds P22 p69 repair: paired coefficient subscripts c_{alpha lambda}, c_{beta tau}, and d_{gamma lambda} are restored in the independence display and prose.
Adds P22 p69 repair: displayed H(x), G(x), and F(x) relations are congruences modulo C_i, not ordinary equalities.
Records p65-p68 no-new-patch traps: earlier RA62 repairs for formulas (21)-(29), C_1, C_{i-1}, zeta, and omega-family loci are already present.
XeLaTeX compiled twice; package reports a 466-page German cumulative PDF with no fatal errors and only pre-existing font substitutions.
quality_label: targeted R126 Paper 22 German source-support addendum through p069; source-support evidence only, not whole-paper certification, not whole-corpus certification, not multilingual synchronization, not a critical edition
caveat: Source witnesses are best-available and mixed quality: GDZ full pages are 600ppi for pp.64 and 66 and 400ppi for pp.65, 67, 68, and 69; 1000dpi crops are inspection enlargements from a 360ppi embedded RA source and do not create native 1000ppi detail. The package is strong for the listed loci and no-new-patch traps but remains below strict native 650+ ppi certification for all of P22.
next_action: Use this p064-p069 package as the current Paper 22 addendum for the next deliberate compact Noether rollup; retain the earlier p053-only, p053+p055-p058, and p053+p055-p061 packages as provenance only.
